children: Pro-Dex reported fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter revenue of $20.4 million, a 17% increase year-over-year, and full-year revenue of $77.5 million, up 16% from FY2025. The company posted Q4 net income of $2.9 million ($0.87 diluted) and fiscal 2026 net income of $13.7 million ($4.12 diluted). Management attributed revenue growth to resumed shipments of a largest customer’s next-generation orthopedic handpiece and the February acquisition of Advanced Precision Machining.
Quarterly revenue (three months ended June 30, 2026): $20.405 million, up $2.9 million (17%) from Q4 FY2025.
Quarterly gross profit: $7.091 million; gross margin increased to 35% for the quarter (from 20% in Q4 FY2025).
Operating income for the quarter: $3.529 million (up from $1.344 million in Q4 FY2025).
Quarterly net income: $2.857 million; diluted EPS $0.87.
Fiscal year revenue (year ended June 30, 2026): $77.548 million, up $10.955 million (16%) from FY2025; fiscal year net income: $13.662 million; diluted EPS $4.12.
Revenue growth driven primarily by increased shipments of a largest customer's next-generation orthopedic handpiece after a prior product hold was released.
Acquisition of Advanced Precision Machining (APM) completed February 9, 2026; APM contributed $718,000 in revenue since acquisition and added favorable margins.
Gross margin improvement attributed to favorable product mix, better absorption of indirect manufacturing costs, and contributions from APM.

Operating expense increases reflect integration and support activities for growth, including APM administrative costs, consulting support for manufacturing, and increased personnel and bonus accruals.

title: Pro-Dex posts fiscal 2026 sales of $77.5M, Q4 revenue up 17% and net income $13.7M
